C0418.title: Research on MFA Bypass Attack Techniques
C0418.summary: A study on multi-factor authentication uncovers various MFA bypass methods, including exploit-based attacks, man-in-the-middle attacks, data theft, and weaknesses in one-time password distribution. The research identifies brute-forcing tokens as a common attack vector for bypassing MFA.

references.title: Beyond Passwords: The Essence and Impact of Multi-Factor Authentication in Cybersecurity
